The '''MT/191 drop-ship''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], [[Troop transport/Legends|troop transport]], and [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] manufactured by [[Meller & Dax]].

==Characteristics==
[[Meller & Dax]]'s MT/191 drop-ship was a [[Troop transport/Legends|troop transport]] and [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] designed to drop [[Company/Legends|company]]-sized [[Army/Legends|army]] formations from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] into combat zones.<ref name="RoE" /> Measuring 52.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], the drop-ship was crewed by a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and carried one hundred and sixty [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="ISB" /> MT/191s had a cargo capacity of two hundred [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]], and consumables to last a single [[Standard day/Legends|day]].<ref name="ISB2" />

The MT/191 drop-ship was designed to rapidly drop from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] to the surface of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in a controlled powerdive. Before launching, the drop-ship was covered in [[VACX]], an ablative coating designed to burn off during [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] re-entry. As the drop-ship plummeted to the surface,<ref name="ISB" /> the ablative coating protected the drop-ship from the high-friction temperature of re-entry,<ref name="RoE" /> protecting the ship before it landed in a controlled fashion. MT/191s were also able to approach and land on the surface of a planet in a normal manner.<ref name="ISB" /> The MT/191 could reach speeds of 1,200 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] during a rapid drop, and speeds of 650 kilometers an hour during the return flight.<ref name="ISB2" />

The MT/191 employed a single light [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] for defense, located directly above the cockpit. The cannon was generally retracted into the body of the drop-ship, and could only fire when extended.<ref name="ISB" /> The laser cannon could not be extended during an atmospheric drop.<ref name="RoE" /> The weapon was not intended for combat, and was only to be used as a deterrent as the ship traveled through combat zones.<ref name="ISB" /> Underpowered, it was only intended for use as an anti-personnel and anti-vehicle weapon during landing operations.<ref name="RoE" />

==History==
An older design, the MT/191 was primarily used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to drop [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] companies into combat. [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] employed their own [[Assault shuttle/Legends|assault shuttles]], and did not use the MT/191. When not being used in a combat capacity, the MT/191 was used to transfer personnel and cargo through the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="RoE" />

Standard Imperial doctrine called for MT/191s to land in sufficient numbers at landing sites that had been pre-arranged and pre-bombed. [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] were ticketed for escort duty during landing operations.<ref name="RoE" /> 1,860 MT/191s were assigned to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]],<ref name="DSTC">''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref> and they were assigned to [[Torpedo Sphere/Legends|Torpedo Spheres]] as well.<ref name="LoE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>

The [[Special Unit squadron]] of the [[Scimitar assault wing]] employed two [[Flight group/Legends|flights]] of the MT/191 drop-ship. Primarily used to ferry ground troops to the surface during combined assault operations. When not in combat, the drop-ships were employed as cargo vessels and shuttles. They were classified as combat craft in the wing's organizational chart, and not as utility craft.<ref name="ISB" />

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] captured several MT/191s during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and employed them as troop transport and shuttles for [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]. However, the Alliance found obtaining sufficient VACX to coat the ships to be difficult, and instead resorted to applying "home-brew" formulas. While a mix of [[air-foam]]/[[Silica/Legends|silicate]] [[Ceramic/Legends|ceramic]] gave the best results, other mixtures had been known to fuse, melt, burn-off, or ignite while in transit.<ref name="RoE" />
